questions.question_text: Which of the following is the primary criterion for 'Financial Status Verification' for a PEEF scholarship applicant?
options: Parents' total land ownership
Total monthly income of parents/guardian
Number of siblings currently studying
Distance of residence from the university
questions.explanation: Financial eligibility is primarily determined by the documented monthly income of the parents or the head of the household.

questions.question_text: What document is usually required to verify the monthly income of a government employee applying for a PEEF scholarship?
options: A personal affidavit
A signed letter from a neighbor
The latest salary slip issued by the department
A bank statement only
questions.explanation: For government employees, the official salary slip serves as the most authentic verification of monthly income.

questions.question_text: What is the threshold for 'monthly income' typically used to determine financial eligibility for PEEF?
options: Maximum 30,000 PKR
Maximum 45,000 PKR
The income should be below the PEEF defined poverty line
Income does not matter
questions.explanation: Financial eligibility is determined based on the PEEF poverty line threshold, which is adjusted according to their specific guidelines for each academic year.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is considered a valid proof of 'Parental Income' for a self-employed applicant?
options: An electricity bill
An income certificate verified by a Gazetted Officer or Union Council
A personal letter from the student
A copy of the applicant's CNIC
questions.explanation: For self-employed individuals, a formal income certificate attested by an authorized authority is required to authenticate the claim.

questions.question_text: Why does PEEF request an affidavit from the applicant during the financial status verification process?
options: To confirm the applicant has never traveled abroad
To verify the truthfulness of the income declaration and financial need
To ensure the applicant is not currently married
To confirm the applicant's permanent residence
questions.explanation: The affidavit serves as a legal declaration by the student that all financial information provided is accurate to the best of their knowledge.

questions.question_text: For a private sector employee, what document is mandatory to provide as proof of income?
options: Bank statement only
Salary Slip attested by the employer
Tax return certificate
Property ownership document
questions.explanation: A salary slip verified by the organization/employer is the standard document for salaried individuals to prove their monthly income.

questions.question_text: Does the ownership of agricultural land impact the 'Financial Status Verification'?
options: No, only salary is checked
Yes, it is factored into the total household income
Only if the land is outside Punjab
Only if the land is used for commercial purposes
questions.explanation: Total household financial status, including income from agriculture, is considered to assess whether the student meets the financial need criteria.

questions.question_text: Why might a student be required to provide utility bills (electricity/gas) during the application?
options: To check if the applicant lives in an urban area
To assess the lifestyle and approximate household expenditure as a proxy for financial status
To verify the age of the house
To confirm the applicant is not living in a hostel
questions.explanation: Utility bills provide an indicator of a household's socio-economic status and consumption patterns, aiding in financial status verification.

questions.question_text: If an applicant's parent is retired, what document is required for income verification?
options: Pension book/Pension slip
Last salary certificate
Retirement certificate only
Bank statement of the last 10 years
questions.explanation: For retired personnel, the pension document serves as the official proof of current monthly income.

questions.question_text: Are assets like personal vehicles included in the financial assessment?
options: No, only liquid cash is assessed
Yes, they may be considered as part of the overall financial profile
Only if the vehicle is brand new
Only if the vehicle is a commercial truck
questions.explanation: PEEF evaluates the overall financial standing, which can include assessment of household assets to determine the level of financial need.

questions.question_text: What specific document is required to verify the monthly income of a deceased parent in a PEEF application?
options: Pension book
Death certificate issued by a registered medical practitioner
An affidavit stating no income source
Bank statement of the last 6 months
questions.explanation: In cases of deceased parents, a legal affidavit is required to confirm the current financial status and lack of income from that parent.

questions.question_text: How does PEEF verify the income of daily-wage earners?
options: By asking for a government-certified tax return
By requiring a salary slip
By requesting a 'Non-Objection' certificate from the local union council
By requesting an income certificate verified by a Gazetted Officer
questions.explanation: Since daily wagers do not have formal salary slips, an income certificate verified by a relevant local authority or Gazetted officer acts as valid proof.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is excluded when calculating the household monthly income for PEEF?
options: Basic salary
Agricultural income
Rental income
One-time medical insurance reimbursement
questions.explanation: Recurring income streams are considered, but one-time reimbursements for medical expenses are usually excluded from regular monthly household income.
